description: L'organisation des lignes de transport en commun du Val d'Essonne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de communes du Val d'Essonne. The creation, organisation and management of public transport lines is the responsibility of Île-de-France Mobilités (IDFM) in Ile-de-France. Coverage: Communauté de communes du Val d'Essonne. The portal shows the English title as "The organisation of the public transport lines of the Val d’Essonne" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de communes du Val d'Essonne. Its keywords include transport-mobilite, scolaire, val-essonne, val-dessonne, circuit-scolaire, transport-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in URL. The listing shows 2021-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
